name: validate_environment
purpose: Check whether the required local GIS and NTL Python dependencies are installed and importable.

name: inspect_vector
purpose: Inspect a vector dataset and report metadata such as CRS, bounds, columns, and geometry types.
side_effects: Reads an existing vector dataset without modification.

name: inspect_raster
purpose: Inspect a raster dataset and optionally sample summary statistics from the first band.
side_effects: Reads an existing raster dataset without modification.

name: filter_points_by_polygon
purpose: Filter points by a polygon predicate and write a new vector dataset.
side_effects: Creates a new vector output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: spatial_join_points_to_admin
purpose: Attach admin attributes to points and write a new joined vector dataset.
side_effects: Creates a new vector output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: buffer_points_aeqd
purpose: Create AEQD buffers around points and write a new polygon dataset.
side_effects: Creates a new vector output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: dissolve_intersections
purpose: Dissolve intersecting polygons into clustered geometries and write a new vector dataset.
side_effects: Creates a new vector output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: clip_raster
purpose: Clip a raster using vector geometries and write a new raster file.
side_effects: Creates a new raster output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: reproject_raster
purpose: Reproject a raster into a destination CRS and write a new raster file.
side_effects: Creates a new raster output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: mosaic_rasters
purpose: Mosaic multiple rasters into a new raster output.
side_effects: Creates a new raster output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: calculate_zonal_statistics
purpose: Calculate zonal nighttime-light metrics for one or more rasters and write a tabular output.
side_effects: Creates a new tabular output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: calculate_ntl_metrics
purpose: Calculate nighttime-light metrics for a raster band without creating output files.
side_effects: Reads an existing raster dataset without modification.

name: composite_ntl_rasters
purpose: Create a new composite raster from aligned nighttime-light rasters.
side_effects: Creates a new raster output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: analyze_ntl_trend
purpose: Analyze nighttime-light trend across aligned rasters inside a vector extent and write slope and p-value rasters.
side_effects: Creates new raster output files and never overwrites existing files.

name: detect_ntl_anomaly
purpose: Detect anomalous nighttime-light pixels from an aligned raster series and write a new anomaly mask raster.
side_effects: Creates a new raster output file and never overwrites an existing file.

name: validate_geodata
purpose: Validate raster and vector inputs for readability, CRS alignment, and spatial compatibility.
